fixed: Frozen state, initial nominal sequence, task/model and 7680 transitions per decision.
pairing: DIAL annealed/fixed use identical standard normals before their different scales; IT uses one larger population with its own fixed-base target.
density: Unweighted occupancy pooled over prediction time, not a physical state probability distribution.
inference: Refinement costs need not decrease monotonically. No closed-loop behavior is inferred.
density_extent: Full extent of saved sample/time points and plans across all passes; shared bins per algorithm; no points discarded.
